title: Learning AI Auditing: A Case Study of Teenagers Auditing a Generative AI Model

bias_targets.methodology: Applying occupation-based text prompts to diverse input images using a generative AI image model, then qualitatively coding the output images for changes in gender presentation (e.g., masculine/feminine presentation, presence of facial hair, or makeup) compared to the original inputs.

Applying occupation-based text prompts to diverse input images and coding the AI-generated outputs for changes in racial representation, assessing visual markers such as skin complexion changes (lighter/darker) and hairstyle alterations (e.g., curlier, straighter, or fade hairstyles).

Analyzing AI-generated images across various occupational prompts by comparing them to the input images and coding for the addition or removal of age-associated visual markers, specifically the presence or absence of wrinkles and gray hair.
